Will it make you go blind? 👀

No. Doctors say research hasn't proven any of the old masturbation myths: not blindness, not hairy palms, not infertility. Cleveland Clinic calls it a normal, healthy part of life that may even reduce stress and help you sleep.

The scary stories go back to doctors like John Harvey Kellogg in the 1800s, who blamed it for acne and epilepsy and prescribed a bland diet, including his corn flakes. (No, that's not why corn flakes were invented. That part is an internet myth too.)

If it ever takes over your life, talk to a doctor.

Sources: Cleveland Clinic, JSTOR Daily, Snopes.
